\section[\texorpdfstring{\bn{প্রত্যক্ষদর্শী} (prôtyôkkhôdôrshī)}{প্রত্যক্ষদর্শী (prôtyôkkhôdôrshī)}]{\bn{প্রত্যক্ষদর্শী} (prôtyôkkhôdôrshī) — an eyewitness}

\label{lesson:BN-C301-protyokkhodorshi}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Bengali for to publicize, then the Bengali for an issue.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \bn{প্রত্যক্ষদর্শী}}
\textbf{\bn{প্রত্যক্ষদর্শী}} — \emph{prôtyôkkhôdôrshī} — \textquotedblleft{}an eyewitness\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\bn{প্রত্যক্ষদর্শীরা} \bn{বলল} \bn{যে} \bn{বাসটা} \bn{লাল} \bn{ছিল।}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{prôtyôkkhôdôrshīrā bôllô je bāsṭā lāl chhilô.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
Eyewitnesses said that the bus was red.
\end{quote}

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\bn{প্রত্যক্ষদর্শী}} (\emph{prôtyôkkhôdôrshī}) is Sanskrit \emph{pratyakṣadarśin}, 'one who has seen with his own eyes' (Monier-Williams): \emph{pratyakṣa}, 'before the eyes', and \emph{darśin}, 'seeing'.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for telling what happened.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{prôtyôkkhôdôrshī}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{prôtyôkkhôdôrshī}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{prôtyôkkhôdôrshīrā bôllô je bāsṭā lāl chhilô.} — Eyewitnesses said that the bus was red.
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Bengali for to publicize, then the Bengali for an issue, then say \emph{prôtyôkkhôdôrshī} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \bn{প্রত্যক্ষদর্শী} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}An eyewitness\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[\texorpdfstring{\bn{বিবরণ} (bibôrôn)}{বিবরণ (bibôrôn)}]{\bn{বিবরণ} (bibôrôn) — an account; a description}

\label{lesson:BN-C301-biboron}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Bengali for an issue, then the Bengali for an eyewitness.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \bn{বিবরণ}}
\textbf{\bn{বিবরণ}} — \emph{bibôrôn} — \textquotedblleft{}an account; a description\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\bn{সাক্ষী} \bn{পুলিশকে} \bn{ঘটনার} \bn{পুরো} \bn{বিবরণ} \bn{দিল।}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{sākkhī pulishke ghôṭônār puro bibôrôn dilô.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
The witness gave the police a full account of what happened.
\end{quote}

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\bn{বিবরণ}} (\emph{bibôrôn}) is Sanskrit \emph{vivaraṇa}, 'an uncovering, a laying open; an explanation' (Monier-Williams): an account lays the events open.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for telling what happened.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{bibôrôn}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{bibôrôn}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{sākkhī pulishke ghôṭônār puro bibôrôn dilô.} — The witness gave the police a full account of what happened.
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Bengali for an issue, then the Bengali for an eyewitness, then say \emph{bibôrôn} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \bn{বিবরণ} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}An account; a description\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[\texorpdfstring{\bn{ভিডিও} (bhiḍio)}{ভিডিও (bhiḍio)}]{\bn{ভিডিও} (bhiḍio) — a video}

\label{lesson:BN-C301-bhidio}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Bengali for an eyewitness, then the Bengali for an account.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \bn{ভিডিও}}
\textbf{\bn{ভিডিও}} — \emph{bhiḍio} — \textquotedblleft{}a video\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\bn{এক} \bn{প্রত্যক্ষদর্শী} \bn{ফোনে} \bn{ঘটনার} \bn{একটা} \bn{ভিডিও} \bn{তুলল।}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{ek prôtyôkkhôdôrshī phone ghôṭônār ekṭā bhiḍio tullô.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
An eyewitness filmed the incident on a phone.
\end{quote}

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\bn{ভিডিও}} (\emph{bhiḍio}) is English \emph{video}, from the Latin for 'I see'. \bn{ভিডিও} \bn{তোলা}, to film, as \textbf{\bn{ছবি} \bn{তোলা}} is to take a photo.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for telling what happened.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{bhiḍio}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{bhiḍio}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{ek prôtyôkkhôdôrshī phone ghôṭônār ekṭā bhiḍio tullô.} — An eyewitness filmed the incident on a phone.
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Bengali for an eyewitness, then the Bengali for an account, then say \emph{bhiḍio} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]

\section[\texorpdfstring{\bn{বিস্তারিত} (bistārit)}{বিস্তারিত (bistārit)}]{\bn{বিস্তারিত} (bistārit) — detailed; in full}

\label{lesson:BN-C301-bistarit}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Bengali for an account, then the Bengali for a video.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \bn{বিস্তারিত}}
\textbf{\bn{বিস্তারিত}} — \emph{bistārit} — \textquotedblleft{}detailed; in full\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\bn{সাংবাদিক} \bn{পরের} \bn{দিন} \bn{বিস্তারিত} \bn{খবর} \bn{দিলেন।}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{sāngbādik pôrer din bistārit khôbôr dilen.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
The next day the journalist gave the full story.
\end{quote}

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\bn{বিস্তারিত}} (\emph{bistārit}) is Sanskrit \emph{vistārita}, 'spread out, fully stated' (Monier-Williams). \bn{বিস্তারিত} \bn{বলা}, to tell in detail.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for telling what happened.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{bistārit}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{bistārit}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{sāngbādik pôrer din bistārit khôbôr dilen.} — The next day the journalist gave the full story.
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Bengali for an account, then the Bengali for a video, then say \emph{bistārit} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]

\section[\texorpdfstring{\bn{যাচাই} \bn{করা} (jāchāi kôrā)}{যাচাই করা (jāchāi kôrā)}]{\bn{যাচাই} \bn{করা} (jāchāi kôrā) — to verify; to check}

\label{lesson:BN-C301-jachai-kora}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Bengali for a video, then the Bengali for detailed.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \bn{যাচাই} \bn{করা}}
\textbf{\bn{যাচাই} \bn{করা}} — \emph{jāchāi kôrā} — \textquotedblleft{}to verify; to check\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\bn{সাংবাদিক} \bn{খবরটা} \bn{প্রকাশ} \bn{করার} \bn{আগে} \bn{যাচাই} \bn{করলেন।}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{sāngbādik khôbôrṭā prôkāsh kôrār āge jāchāi kôrlen.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
The journalist checked the story before publishing it.
\end{quote}

Past (he/she …): \bn{তিনি} \bn{নামটা} \bn{যাচাই} \bn{করলেন}, \emph{tini nāmṭā jāchāi kôrlen}.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\bn{যাচাই} \bn{করা}} (\emph{jāchāi kôrā}) is built on \bn{যাচা}, 'to test' — CDIAL 10449, Sanskrit \emph{yācyatē}, 'is asked', which lists Bengali \emph{jācā}, 'to beg, test' — with \bn{করা}: to put a claim to the question.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for telling what happened.
\end{grammarlens}

  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{jāchāi kôrā}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{sāngbādik khôbôrṭā prôkāsh kôrār āge jāchāi kôrlen.} — The journalist checked the story before publishing it.
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Bengali for a video, then the Bengali for detailed, then say \emph{jāchāi kôrā} again
\end{itemize}
